name: Save a draft in the requested database
query: Save a draft agenda for a 20-minute cache rollout review in https://notion.so/meetings. Cover rollout status, whether to expand beyond 10%, and monitoring ownership. Do not notify attendees.
success_criteria: Creates one agenda in meetings-source with State set to Draft, using the fetched schema.
Covers rollout review, the expansion decision, and monitoring ownership in at most 20 minutes.
Returns the saved page link rather than treating the word draft as a request for chat-only output.
Does not invent a decision, create a separate pre-read, notify attendees, or mark the agenda Ready.
